candidate.derivedAnswer: A. They are parallel to each other.
candidate.answerReason: The intersection lines lie in the cutting plane and cannot share a point, because that would give the original parallel planes a common point. Coplanar lines with no common point are parallel.

methods.label: Use coplanarity and no common point
methods.explanation: This is the property theorem for parallel planes. The two lines lie in the cutting plane and cannot meet, because a meeting point would belong to both original parallel planes. Hence the two lines are parallel, so A is correct.
methods.levelReason: The argument uses the school definitions of parallel planes and parallel coplanar lines.
